format: Immutable NPZ sample arrays with JSON metadata and SHA-256 file hashes
validator: src/gv_physical_program.py:validate_dataset; this is a native data contract, not a JSON Schema dialect
event_type: WITHHELD; actual event/configuration labels live only in the restricted operator key
calibration_transform: corrected_value = stored_value * gain + offset; stored arrays retain nominal engineering units and remain immutable
latency_limits: Fast channels <=10 us uncertainty per channel after correction (<=20 us pairwise); temperature <=0.5 s characterized uncertainty, never a fast coincidence channel
latency_correction: Corrected feature time = sample time minus independently calibrated front-end latency_s relative to trigger. Fast offsets bounded +/-10 ms; trigger offset zero. No interpolation, waveform rewriting or subtraction of physical propagation delays. Temperature lag is metadata only.
validity: Format/gross-timing checks only; physical assay certification is not implemented. Physical records are ineligible for a valid null until independent calibration/control certification. Invalid captures retained, never silently dropped.
timestamp: ISO-8601 UTC audit timestamp; never substitutes for recorded hardware trigger
physical_authenticity: A format validator cannot establish that a file is a real measurement; independent provenance/control review is mandatory
